findings.summary: Use shared measured native execution, deployed-payload/build-identity checks, and image MAD helpers in both scene231 and scene241 input replay tools; remove stale capture files before each phase.
Share the pinned numeric constant helper between Standard alpha lowering and upstream lowering, retaining the existing export.
Carry scalar precision in RecordFieldAssignment metadata instead of branching on a particular UV property name.
Derive Standard alpha decisions from one pinned source expression for generation-time execution and native numeric lowering.
Share Standard base and geometry composition option objects rather than duplicating their configuration.
Use the existing float_or JSON helper for new glTF material extension scalar fields.
Remove the dead pinOnlyExtensions set and unreachable refusal after extension support is installed.
Share the native compile/run fixture helper for glTF pointer transform semantic tests.
Represent resolved, intentionally ignored, and unsupported texture transform pointers explicitly in the owning resolver.
